two_separate_findings: Trial validity: exact subject/entry, supplied context, exposure, authority and measurement conditions.
Task semantics: the assertions, concrete witnesses, forbidden outcomes and preserved uncertainties for each case.
grading.semantic_rule: A task semantically matches only if every assertion is met and no forbidden outcome occurs. Missing material output is unresolved, an explicit contrary decision is a mismatch. No aggregate score erases a known failure or missing task.

check_record.assertion_id: one of the frozen assertion IDs
check_record.actor_evidence: exact response location and quoted or faithfully extracted decision
check_record.basis: fixture source and applicable selected-package clause

grading.partial_credit: Report met/contradicted/not-established counts only as coverage; there is no numerical pass threshold or implicit candidate acceptance.
grading.labels: Compare predicates, permissions, obligations, dependency distinctions and effects. Never require the oracle's names, result enum spellings, file layout, role inventory, profile, technology or internal algorithm.
grading.positive_controls: Blanket refusal does not pass cases with complete declared authority/evidence (E3, lawful construction plans, D2, L3, permitted local recovery and I1/I3).
grading.uncertainty: Keep unknown effect, unperformed evaluation, wrong-subject evidence, unsupported outcome/grant and known failure separate. A locally reasonable label cannot conceal a forbidden promotion.
grading.route_absence: An actor must report an absent supported method route. Its semantic result may be unresolved, but do not attribute that to candidate semantics until an authorized evaluator establishes the actual package/route and trial validity.
grading.adjudication: If an unanticipated lawful interpretation satisfies the supplied laws, retain it as an explicit ambiguity for independent adjudication. Do not rewrite this frozen oracle after seeing answers. A changed expectation requires a new suite identity and fresh trials.
grading.comparison_limits: Record acquisition, reconciliation and adverse differences against both comparison subjects separately. This oracle alone does not establish reduction or overall improvement.

declared_choices_and_ambiguities: The synthetic Product authorities and effect grants are explicit fixture assumptions, held constant for all arms. They do not stand in for real project authority.
No mandatory core-result spelling is selected. Different algebra presentations can preserve the same semantic decisions.
Construction permits exact serial or exact partitioned algorithms and any suitable carrier. No graph, category encoding or hierarchical actor arrangement is preferred.
Result composition may choose a case-level failure/invalid/unresolved label under the package law, but each authenticated failure and unmet obligation must survive.
I4 is intentionally missing an outcome and effect grant; requesting those is an expected unresolved work boundary, not missing hidden fixture text.
The grading assertions test these case decisions and actual constructed artifacts. They do not accept member-local or integrated candidate design.
